noTranslation: I-Mouseion ayikabi nakho ukuhumutsha kwesizinda somphakathi ngalolu limi: {language}.

pdLiving: Umhumutshi usaphila: umsebenzi uvikelwe phakathi nokuphila kwakhe neminyaka engu-{n} emva kwalokho.
lineDrift: Kule ngoma ukuhumutsha kunemigqa engu-{a} kanti okwangempela kune-{b}, ngakho ukuqondana kungashibilika ngomugqa owodwa.
bookOnly: Lokhu kuhumutsha akunazo izinkomba zemigqa, ngakho kuboniswa ingoma ngengoma.
legalDraft: Umbhalo wesikhashana. Shintsha imininingwane esemabakaki ayisikwele ngaphambi kokuba isayithi ivulelwe umphakathi.
legalImprintIntro: Ulwazi ngokomthetho osebenzayo ngezinsizakalo eziku-inthanethi (isibonelo § 5 DDG eJalimane).
legalContentText: Okuqukethwe kwale sayithi kulungiswe ngokucophelela, kodwa asikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphelele, kulungile noma kusesikhathini. Isimo sesizinda somphakathi sibalwa ngemithetho eyenziwe lula futhi akusona iseluleko somthetho.
legalLinksText: Le sayithi ixhumanisa namasayithi angaphandle. Asilawuli okuqukethwe kwawo futhi asinamthwalo wakho. Uma sithola ukuthi ikhasi elixhunyiwe liphula umthetho, sizosusa isixhumanisi.
legalCopyrightText: Imibhalo ku-Mouseion iyisizinda somphakathi noma isetshenziswa ngokwamalayisensi ayo. Umsebenzi ngamunye usho imithombo yawo, njenge-Wikisource, Perseus Digital Library ne-Deutsches Textarchiv (CC BY-SA 4.0). Uma ucabanga ukuthi umbhalo othile akufanele ube lapha, xhumana nathi.
numberPairing: Imigqa ihlanganiswa ngenombolo, njengakokwangempela. Lokhu kuhumutsha kunika imigqa yakho izinombolo ngokwako futhi kude, ngakho okuqukethwe kwakho kuqhela emugqeni wesiGreki onenombolo efanayo.
